title: Dandruff
body:
**Mod Name:** Dandruff Mod  
**Tagline:** *Flakes, snowballs, golems, and hygiene – now with shampoo and commands!*

### 📝 Description

From tiny flakes to full-blown dandruff chaos – this mod turns a silly idea into a full gameplay system.

Craft a **Comb**, collect **Dandruff Flakes**, throw **Dandruff Snowballs**, summon a **Dandruff Golem**, wash your head with **Shampoo**, track your **cleanliness level**, and control everything with **commands**!

Perfect for pranksters, roleplay servers, or anyone who wants to turn personal hygiene into a weapon.

![items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62ba25a48e2fdf963e936b6aabee684f6e5c8075.png)
![Dandruff snowball](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a5e38078e73ff67480b19793a2bb96018a019677_0.webp)
![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3212921aaac9f4a95ded7a4e0b723d110aab4be3.png)


---

### ✨ Features

- **🧹 Comb** – Right-click to use. Generates Dandruff Flakes (with cooldown).  
- **⚪ Dandruff Flake** – Basic drop. Can be crafted into Dandruff Snowballs.  
- **☃️ Dandruff Snowball** – Throwable projectile! Hits cause the **Itch** effect (slowness + camera shake).  
- **🧴 Shampoo** – Right-click to use. Cleans your head, reduces your dandruff level, and removes the Itch effect. Can be crafted.  
- **🧌 Dandruff Golem** – A new golem made from Dandruff Flakes and a carved pumpkin. Follows you, attacks mobs, and spreads the Itch effect on hit.  
- **📊 Cleanliness System** – Every player has a hidden **dandruff accumulation level**. It increases over time or when you use the Comb. High level causes random Itch effects on yourself and makes mobs more attracted to you.  
- **💻 Commands** –  
  - `/dandruff get <player>` – Check current dandruff level.  
  - `/dandruff set <player> <value>` – Set a player's dandruff level.  
  - `/dandruff cleanse <player>` – Instantly remove all dandruff.  
  - `/dandruff reload` – Reload config.  
- **⚙️ Fully multiplayer ready** – All features sync perfectly on servers.

---

### 🧪 Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.21.1  
- **Mod Loader:** NeoForge  
- **Dependencies:** None

---

### 📦 Installation

1. Download the `.jar` file.  
2. Put it in your `mods` folder (NeoForge installed).  
3. Launch the game, grab your Comb, and watch your head get … interesting.

---

### ❓ Why?

Because even Minecraft heads need a little dandruff sometimes.  
*No actual dandruff was harmed in the making of this mod.*
